scope.source_inspection: Assessed the complete supplied pinned diff. Read focused loader validation, event navigation, stable-offset rendering, and history-refresh context. The commit, tree, fixed point, and diff hash matched before checks. The commit, tree, diff hash, and clean tracked status matched again after the native run.

criteria_assessment.assessment: Implemented in source and covered by the modal tests. The event list has a canonical ticket identity, tracker state, and receipt counts above it.

Implemented. Identity-valid receipts pass duplicate-ID and parent-graph validation before counts become available. Review and fix phases are counted separately. Invalid fields do not contribute. Orphaned and cyclic graphs leave counts unavailable. Counts explicitly describe recorded receipts, not quality or completion.
Implemented. Event rows label event identity, phase, execution, optional verdict, and source commit separately. Source commits never occupy the execution field.

Implemented and covered by automated tests. The fresh native failure frame also shows Execution: completed and Review verdict: FAILURE as separate labels. The native assertion expects a different case-sensitive label and stops, so its acceptance gate is not satisfied.

Implemented. Enter opens a dedicated detail view. Execution, optional review verdict, warnings, and readable body precede extended evidence. The fresh native failure frame confirms this ordering at 120 by 40 in colour.

Implemented in source and automated scrolling checks. Full recorded commit/tree values, current source values, workspace, branch, session, event reference, and raw recorded fields remain scrollable. Native coverage of all required terminal layouts remains incomplete.

Implemented. Source comparison distinguishes matched, stale, and unavailable. Invalid events remain inspectable. Source authority and validation rules are not changed. Refresh failure removes current source values from retained content.

Implemented. Dependencies and unresolved blockers remain below the event rows and reachable by scrolling. Existing transition guards remain unchanged. Automated tests cover blocked actions from event detail and failed refresh.
Implemented. Changed-file counts come only from structured changed_files or a nonnegative integer changed_file_count. There is no prose inference.

Implemented and covered by modal/live tests. Stable event IDs retain selection after insertion. Detail and list use separate pane offsets. Esc and the Events ancestor return to the selected event list.

Implemented in source and automated checks. Empty, loading, unreadable, and failed-refresh histories have distinct messages. Failed refresh retains previous readable events, invalidates source freshness, and keeps unsafe transitions blocked. Fresh native output records loading at all three required sizes in colour.
Implemented and covered by canonical fresh-chat/action tests. Event inspection retains the current ticket target rather than the historical event or recorded workspace.

The changed rendering uses the existing sanitization and Unicode wrapping path. Explicit field labels preserve meaning without colour. Files, copy, fresh-chat, descriptions, workspace shortcuts, and action targeting remain independent. The affected suite passes. Full fresh colour/monochrome terminal acceptance remains unavailable because the harness stops early.
